description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Election of new Vice Chairman for Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha). It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, making it clearly about electoral processes at the local government level, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
